name: TranslateX for TranslatePress
author: edo888

sections.description:
This plugin connects the TranslateX automatic translator API, a powerful neural machine translation engine, directly into TranslatePress, allowing you to effortlessly translate your content with advanced automation.

External services

This plugin connects to TranslateX API to obtain translations.

It sends the original text strings you choose to translate every time there is a translation request from TranslatePress (e.g., every time TranslatePress discovers new content).
The data is transmitted over a secure HTTPS connection to api.translatex.com and processed on TranslateX servers located in the United States and the European Union.

This service is provided by “GTranslate, Inc.”: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/translatex-for-translatepress directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Settings → TranslatePress → Automatic Translation, select the TranslateX engine, and enter your TranslateX API key
  4. (Optional) To prevent TranslatePress’s default daily limits, either disable the “Limit machine translation / characters per day” option or increase the limit significantly (e.g., 100x)
sections.faq:
Do I need to register to get a TranslateX API key?

Yes, registration is required. You can sign up on our website: translatex.com

Is it free?

Yes, we have a Free plan for personal or non-commercial sites. For commercial projects or bigger needs, upgrade to a premium plan.

Which version of TranslatePress is required to use TranslateX?

We have tested TranslateX starting from TranslatePress version 2.9.16. The plugin works with both the free and paid versions of TranslatePress.

It doesn’t work, what to do?

Please check Translatex for TranslatePress Forum and feel free to create a new topic if you cannot find answers.

Which languages are supported?

We support the following languages: English, Arabic, Bulgarian, Bengali, Czech, Danish, German, Greek, Spanish, Finnish, French, Hindi, Croatian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Hebrew, Japanese, Korean, Lithuanian, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)
